source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: "【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). Log into the BMC and run the following command and ensure you get a reply. Refer to PID : 1114953 for other devices expected on the bus. i2cget -f -y 5 0x71 #Read MUX ports enabled i2ctransfer -y 5 w1@0x71 0x01 #Enable MUX Port 0""
